title: Stipulation and Title Holdbacks on Contracts Funded under Dealer Retail Agreements
content:
Each holdback type on a contract is released or forfeited once. Under the Dealer Retail Agreements a funded contract can carry two holdback types — the stip holdback and the title holdback — and each runs on its own clock.

## Rules

**Stip holdback.** The stip holdback is released within 2 business days after the post-funding stipulations are cleared, and is forfeited when they are not cleared within 30 calendar days after funding.

**Title holdback.** The title holdback is released within 2 business days after the title or ELT confirmation naming the company as lienholder is received, and is forfeited when it is not received within 90 calendar days after funding.

**Title delivery deadline.** The dealer must deliver a title or ELT confirmation naming the company as lienholder within the title delivery deadline, counted in calendar days after the contract date. A title received after the title delivery deadline from the contract date still counts toward the dealer's title delinquency until it arrives.

**Once per holdback type.** Each holdback type on a contract is released or forfeited once: where the company's record already shows a release or a forfeiture of that holdback type on that contract, it is not released or forfeited again. The other holdback type on the same contract is a separate holdback and is decided on its own.

## Deadline table

| Dealer Program tier | Post-funding stip deadline (calendar days after funding) | Title delivery deadline (calendar days after the contract date) | Title holdback forfeit (calendar days after funding) | Release after the condition is met (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dealer Program Bronze | 30 | 30 | 90 | 2 |
| Dealer Program Silver | 30 | 30 | 90 | 2 |
| Dealer Program Gold | 30 | 45 | 90 | 2 |
| Dealer Program Platinum | 30 | 45 | 90 | 2 |
| Dealer Program Diamond | 30 | 45 | 90 | 2 |
| Dealer Program Elite | 30 | 60 | 90 | 2 |

## Title delinquency count

A dealer's title-delinquent contracts, counted at the current date, are the agreement's funded contracts with no title received whose contract date plus the title delivery deadline is earlier than the current date.

| Contract with no title received | Counted as title-delinquent |
|---|---|
| Contract date plus the deadline falls before the current date | Yes |
| Contract date plus the deadline falls on the current date | No — that date is not earlier than the current date |
| Contract date plus the deadline falls after the current date | No |

Once the title is received the contract no longer counts.

## Hypothetical timeline

A contract under a Dealer Program Gold agreement (hypothetical dates) is dated on day 0 and funded on day 2. The Gold title delivery deadline is 45 calendar days after the contract date, so day 45. The title arrives on day 50.

- On each current date from day 46 until the title is received on day 50, the contract counts as title-delinquent.
- The title arrived 48 days after funding, within 90 calendar days after funding, so the title holdback is not forfeited; it is released within 2 business days after the title was received.

## How holdbacks move the agreement's balance

The agreement's holdback balance increases when holdbacks are withheld at funding and decreases when a holdback is released or forfeited. A release or forfeiture is recorded once per holdback type per contract, with its date, the amount released or forfeited, the holdback type, and whether it was released after the condition was met or forfeited. A title received from the dealer is recorded once per contract with the date it was received.
